name: 鶏繁 総本店
address_ja: 〒105-0004 東京都港区新橋2-9-17 竹本ビル 1F
cuisine: A 1971 Shinbashi yakitori house grilling 南部赤鶏 (Nanbu red chicken, raised on pesticide-free feed and alkaline water and butchered the same day) over charcoal at a cramped ground-floor counter where the menu carries no prices at all; regulars finish with the coarse-ground 鶏そぼろ丼. Tabelog's diners put dinner at ¥6,000–¥7,999 a head; the takeaway window sells 親子丼 with soup at ¥750 and 三色丼 at ¥850.
neighborhood: Shinbashi 2-chōme, 204 m from JR Shinbashi — 3 min from the Hibiya-guchi exit (Yamanote / Keihin-Tōhoku lines), 3 min from Uchisaiwaichō (Toei Mita line), 4 min from Shinbashi (Tokyo Metro Ginza line), 6 min from Shinbashi (Toei Asakusa line)
gf_detail: No gluten-free claim and no allergen page anywhere on 鶏繁's own site, on its branch pages, or on Tabelog. Assume wheat throughout: tare-glazed skewers are brushed with ordinary wheat soy sauce, and the published 御品書き carries 赤鶏唐揚げ (wheat-battered fried chicken), 鶏ぎょうざ (wheat wrappers), チヂミ (wheat-flour pancake), 鶏煮込みラーメン (wheat noodles), レバームース served on ガーリックトースト, and そぼろ丼 simmered in soy sauce. One shared charcoal grill runs tare and salt skewers side by side. Nothing published says the kitchen will handle a wheat allergy, so a celiac has to raise it in person before ordering — hence 'ask', not any higher tier.
vegan_detail: A chicken specialist: every skewer is poultry or poultry offal, and the shop's whole identity is single-farm 南部赤鶏. The nominally plant dishes — 自家製豆腐, 大根サラダ, トマトサラダ, ねぎ巻 — are either wrapped in chicken or dressed with soy and dashi seasonings the shop does not describe, and 南部玉子焼き is egg. No vegan item is published and none was reported by any reviewer.

roles: 株式会社鶏繁 代表者: 林 雅敏 (Masatoshi Hayashi, present representative)
chef_bio.origin: Shinbashi, Minato-ku — the company has never moved off the 新橋2-9-17 block, where the 総本店, 総本店となり and 鶏繁厨房 all still stand
chef_bio.background: 鶏繁's own site dates the business to 1971, when founder 播元繁雄 opened 「しんばし鶏繁1号店」 in the high-growth years, choosing Shinbashi because the salaryman crowd under the railway arches wanted a quick drink and good skewers. The company incorporated as 株式会社鶏繁 in 1981, is headed today by 林雅敏, and reported ¥700 million in sales in 平成22. It now runs five direct branches — 総本店, 総本店となり and 鶏繁厨房 (all on the same Shinbashi block) plus 麻布十番店 and 大丸東京店 — with two affiliated shops in Roppongi and Shiba-Daimon and a related company, 株式会社マクゲンフーズ. The Shinbashi flagship seats 24, is entirely non-smoking and cash only; the ground-floor counter cannot be reserved by phone, which is why reviewers advise arriving at the 17:00 open.
chef_bio.philosophy: 「本物をただ美味しく」「良いものを美味しく」 — real chicken plus a craftsman's hand, nothing else: 「一本、一本、大切に串打ちをし、そして焼き続けてきました」.
chef_bio.specialty: Charcoal yakitori off 南部赤鶏, and the 鶏そぼろ丼 (coarse-ground, lightly seasoned; 小 comes in a rice bowl, 大 in a donburi). Reviewers single out 秘密の秘宝焼き, a scarce cut from the inner thigh of a hen that sells out early.

anecdotes.text: The site explains the sourcing plainly: 「鶏の健康を考えた緑豊かな大自然の中で無農薬飼料とアルカリ水によって育てられた南部赤鶏を使用し、その日にさばいた鶏肉だけを使っています。」

A 2026 reviewer warns that no prices appear on the in-store menu at all — two people came to ¥18,730 — and that the first-floor counter takes no bookings, so 17:00 or just before 18:30 are the openings.
Tabelog's 備考 field notes that 鶏繁 総本店 is a 瓶コーク提供店 — one of the shops that still serves Coca-Cola in the glass bottle.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: torishige.com (the company's own site) carries the founding story (1971, 播元繁雄, 「しんばし鶏繁1号店」), the 南部赤鶏 sourcing statement, the branch list, and a 総本店 page giving 東京都港区新橋2-9-17, 17:00〜23:30 (LO 23:00), Sundays closed, an 8/15–8/18 summer break, 24 seats, no private rooms, and the note 「一階のカウンターは電話予約不可」. Its company page gives 株式会社鶏繁, 代表者 林雅敏, 設立 1971年（本店営業開始）/1981年株式会社化, capital ¥10 m, sales ¥700 m (平成22). Tabelog 13012718 files it as 新橋/焼き鳥・鳥料理・居酒屋, rating 3.56 over 480 reviews, address 新橋2-9-17 竹本ビル1F, coordinates 35.667037/139.756118, phone 03-3508-9532, 204 m from Shinbashi station, cash only, all non-smoking, and lists the takeaway lunch prices (親子丼スープ付き ¥750, 三色丼スープ付き ¥850).

gf_cross_contamination.text: One charcoal grill serves the whole 24-seat shop, with tare-dipped and salt skewers cooked together; the same kitchen fries 赤鶏唐揚げ and チヂミ and boils ramen. No separate line or fryer is claimed anywhere.

soy_sauce_wheat.text: The tare and the そぼろ丼 seasoning are ordinary Japanese soy sauce — the shop names no gluten-free tamari, so assume wheat.

vegan_cross_contact.text: A single-protein chicken house: even the vegetable skewers (ねぎ巻) are wrapped in chicken and grilled over the same coals as everything else.

staff_allergy_handling.text: Neither torishige.com nor Tabelog publishes an allergen list, an allergy contact, or any statement that dietary requests are accepted. Ask at the counter; nothing is promised in advance.

cultural_comfort.note: An old-school Shinbashi salaryman counter, not a tourist room. The ground floor is a narrow charcoal counter where the gap behind the stools barely fits one person, and it takes no phone bookings — arrive at the 17:00 open or just before 18:30. Upstairs, reached by a steep outside staircase, there are tables and a tatami room, and reviewers report the staff were warm with children there. Cash only (no cards, no e-money, no QR pay), entirely non-smoking, and the in-store menu carries no prices at all, so budget ¥6,000–¥8,000 a head and expect the bill to be a surprise. No English menu is advertised, and closing time is enforced firmly.

enrich_note: Confirmed. The light record read 「新橋 鶏繁」 with genre 焼き鳥 and neighbourhood 港区新橋 / 新橋駅; that resolves to 鶏繁 総本店, the 1971 flagship of the 鶏繁 group, at 港区新橋2-9-17 竹本ビル1F. Evidence: (1) Tabelog nationwide keyword search for 鶏繁 (double-encoded rstLst form, desktop UA, HTTP 200, 55件) returns the group's eight Tokyo shops, of which exactly one is in 新橋 — 13012718, 鶏繁 総本店. Its Restaurant JSON-LD gives the address above, 35.667036637916375/139.75611788308652, 焼き鳥・鳥料理・居酒屋, ¥6,000〜¥7,999, tel 03-3508-9532, rating 3.56 over 480 reviews. (2) The company's own site torishige.com confirms the same address, phone and hours for the 総本店 and dates the business to 1971 under founder 播元繁雄 as 「しんばし鶏繁1号店」; its company page gives 株式会社鶏繁, 代表者 林雅敏. (3) A GSI address lookup (msearch.gsi.go.jp) for 東京都港区新橋2-9-17 returns 139.756561/35.666889, about 40 m from Tabelog's coordinate — the two agree. Coordinates moved from the neighbourhood-centroid pin (35.666/139.758) to Tabelog's own, roughly 180 m; loc_precise set true. Note for the merge: the same street address also holds 鶏繁 総本店となり (13300353) and 鶏繁厨房 (13026583), so watch for pin stacking if those are ever added. GF left at 'ask' — the shop publishes no allergen information of any kind.

enrich_note: UNRESOLVED — recommend human review or deletion. Searches run and what each returned: (1) Tabelog nationwide keyword search for 新橋いろり (double-encoded rstLst form, desktop UA) — HTTP 200, 0件: no business in Japan bears that name. (2) Tabelog area-scoped search inside 新橋・汐留 (tokyo/A1301/A130103) for いろり — HTTP 200, 18件, and none is named simply 「いろり」. The four real candidates it surfaces are いろり村 (13052846, 港区新橋3-15-5 新橋M2ビル2F, 35.665254/139.756135, 居酒屋・ダイニングバー・日本酒バー, a one-man counter at ¥4,000–4,999); 権兵衛のいろり屋 新橋店 (13315297, 新橋2-15-9 S-PLAZA弥生Ⅱ 3F, 居酒屋・鳥料理・海鮮); 暫亭 いろり (13032819, 西新橋1-17-7, 海鮮・しゃぶしゃぶ・居酒屋); and いろり庵 然 (13020296, 新橋3-2-3), which Tabelog already marks 【閉店】. (3) Yahoo Japan exact-phrase 「"新橋いろり"」 — HTTP 200, no shop of that name; the hits are Toyama's いろり村 and photo pages for いろり庵 然. (4) Follow-up Yahoo legs 「site:r.gnavi.co.jp 新橋 いろり」 and 「新橋 いろり 郷土料理 居酒屋」 came back HTTP 429 on three separate attempts spaced minutes apart (rate-limited, not a negative), so they carry no weight either way. The light record's genre string 居酒屋・郷土料理 fits いろり村 best — its master, 石田雄三, is from Toyama and the Shinbashi menu ran Toyama 酒肴 (昆布巻きかまぼこ, 昆布〆) beside house-smoked plates — but two things stop me enriching under that name. Nothing in the light record distinguishes いろり村 from the other three, and いろり村's operating status is doubtful: Tabelog carries the banner 「このお店は店舗情報の確認が取れていないため掲載保留中です」, its newest review is 2024/05, one reviewer notes the building was slated for redevelopment 「店主の故郷が富山で、今後どうなるか気になる」, and the homepage Tabelog lists for it, irorimura.net, now presents いろり村 as a Toyama City shop at 〒930-0063 富山県富山市太田口通り1-6-21 with no Tokyo branch shown. Coordinates left unchanged, loc_precise false. A human should decide between deleting this record and re-creating it as いろり村 once the closure question is settled.

No unagi restaurant called 東正 could be placed in Shinbashi or anywhere in Japan. Coordinates left unchanged, loc_precise false.
